_notes.source: iOS 1.7.4 decomp build/re/decomp-ios/*.c + constants read from build/re/ios/Blockheads (Mach-O __TEXT/__DATA). Assets: APK 1.7.6 assets/.
_notes.coords: GL UI (MJView frames) use points in a centre-origin, y-up space: x in [-halfW,halfW], y in [-halfH,halfH]; a frame {x,y,w,h} has (x,y) at its BOTTOM-left. CSS: left = halfW + x, top = halfH - (y + h).
_notes.layoutClass: 'phone' = screenWidth<415 || screenHeight<415 (iOS points, landscape). Then f=0.75, else f=1. S = 160 if screenWidth<415 else 200.
_notes.blend: GL UI uses premultiplied blending glBlendFunc(ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); textures are tinted multiplicatively: frag = tex * color.
_notes.certainty: 'certain' = read directly from code/data; 'derived' = computed from code; 'uncertain' = decompiler ambiguity or not found.

mainMenuBackground.clearColor: unknown (backdrop fully covered by the rotated quad)
mainMenuBackground.quad: square centred on screen, side = 3 * max(halfW, halfH) (i.e. +-1.5*max), full texture, image upright

rotation.directionNote: positive = CCW in y-up GL (uncertain sign after decompile)

stars.data: stars.json (2048 x [dx,dy,dz,w]; unit-sphere directions + brightness w in 1.8..8.43) dumped from DAT_1005b15d8
stars.draw: GL_POINTS, additive glBlendFunc(ONE,ONE), shader Star.vsh/fsh: v = pow(w*screenScale/4, 2); gl_PointSize = max(v,1) device px; colour = vec4(v) (white, clamps at 1)
stars.transform: projection = GameView perspective (fov_y = 60deg * min(pinchScale,1), times h/w when h<w; near 1) * Rz(-0.0005*scroll) * R(2pi*a0) * R(2pi*a1) * R(2pi*a2) * scale 64; camera at sphere centre
stars.drift: 3 angles a_i: a_i += dt * speed_i * 0.01; speed_i = (1-dt)*speed_i + dt*goal_i; goal_i = rand[-1,1] rerolled when timer_i (rand[0,1], -= 0.05/s) hits 0
stars.uncertain: exact axes of the three rotations and pinchScale on the menu

clocks.cssHint: face ~ clockFace drawn as near-additive light at ~6% (screen blend, opacity .06); hands ~ opacity .12
clocks.minuteHand: pivot at clock centre; quad x in [-s/12, s/12], y in [-s/12, +2s/3] (s=halfSize); angle = 5*(value_i - k_i*scroll) rad
clocks.hourHand: same pivot; quad x in [-s/12, s/12], y in [-s/12, +5s/12]; angle = minuteAngle/12
clocks.animation: value_i += dt*speed_i*0.5; speed_i = (1-dt)*speed_i + dt*goal_i; goal_i = rand[-1,1] rerolled when timer_i (rand[0,1], -= 0.2/s) <= 0; initial value/speed/goal rand[-1,1]
clocks.drawOrder: background, stars(additive), 5 faces, then hands per clock (minute then hour)

mainMenuBackground.clouds: none on the main menu (cloud1-6.png are World sky only) - certain (no reference in MainMenuUI)

portals.certainty: certain (MainMenuUI::render), rect verified by cropping TileMap.png
portals.texture: GameResources/TileMap.png (512x512 => 32x32 grid of 16px tiles), shader StandardObject, untinted
portals.sourceRect: tile index t -> col = t%32, row = t/32; source = x col*16, y (row-1)*16, w 16, h 32 (two tiles tall, upright)
portals.animation: anim 0..7, +1 every 0.2 s, wraps 7->0 (8 frames, 1.6 s); only world portals animate, create/join are static
portals.glow: no separate glow pass - glow is in the tile art
portals.basePortalPos: x 0; y = 256 (non-phone) else min(176 if screenHeight>=415 else 140, halfH-40)
portals.xOfPortal_i: scroll - f*S*(i+1)  (i=-2 create, -1 join, 0.. worlds); per decompile create sits at +f*S (uncertain sign/ordering)
portals.quad: centre (x_i, baseY); halfW = 15*ps (20*ps when not phone... code: 20 only if both dims >=415), halfH = 30*ps (40*ps likewise)

label.font: BitmapFont standardFont = Fonts/Blockheads_64 at scale 0.25 (16pt), white [1,1,1,1], centred, box 256x16
label.text: 'CREATE WORLD', 'JOIN WORLD', or world name uppercased
label.position: x = x_i, y = baseY - f*ps*40 - 16*ls (text drawn with model scale ls)

portals.previewImage: selected world's 320x320 preview, masked by GameResources/portalPreviewMask.png (mask.r), alpha 0.67*(1-2|offset|) - partially uncertain geometry
portals.scrollSnap: velocity *= 1-min(8dt,1); eases to nearest portal (spacing f*S)

topBar.settingsButton: MJButton 40x40 at top-left (x = paddingLeft-halfW, y = halfH-paddingTop-42); bg InventoryButtonBackground.png / pressed InventoryButtonBackgroundSelected.png; glyph settingsCog.png in frame inset 4 (32x32)
topBar.timeCrystalButton: MJButton (40+extraTextWidth)x40 at top-right (x = halfW-paddingRight-42-extra); same bg textures; crystal icon Items.png rect [176,0,16,16] (uv 0.34424..0.37451, 0.00049..0.06201) drawn 32x32; count text standardFont white right-aligned

buttons_GL.slicing: 3-slice horizontal only: left cap = left half of image drawn h/2 wide, right cap = right half drawn h/2 wide, middle = the single texel column at u=0.5 stretched; full image height stretched to frame height. CSS: border-image: url(img) 0 40 fill / 0 calc(h/2) stretch (for 80px image). Buttons without a title (glyph only) stretch the whole image. dontStretch (toggle) uses w/2 caps.
buttons_GL.pressed: touch-down shows the Selected texture while finger is inside; tap animation: t=1 on touch, t -= 4*dt; scale = 1 - 0.125*(1 - 2*|t^2 - 0.5|) about centre (min 0.875, lasts 0.25 s); table cells disable it
buttons_GL.disabled: background tint rgb*0.67; title colour 0.5 grey
buttons_GL.title: standardFont (Blockheads_64 @0.25 = 16pt) white, alignment centre (default) / left = x+9 / right = x+w-9; text box y = frame.y + h/2 - 8 approx (createTitleWithColor)

toggleButton.size_px: 160x80, drawn stretched to frame (dontStretch => caps w/2)
toggleButton.text: 'ON' offset -w/4 (left half) / 'OFF' offset +w/4 (right half); white standardFont

tableCells_customOptions.row: MJButton height 42, row pitch 40 (2px overlap), full table width
tableCells_customOptions.title: option name uppercased, left aligned (x+9), white 16pt
tableCells_customOptions.value: right aligned titleB, colour [0.67,0.67,0.67,1], offset -20 (if it doesn't fit: value y-8, title y+8)
tableCells_customOptions.arrow: arrowRightTxt.png glyph 16x16 at (x+w-24, y+14) for submenu/text-entry rows
tableCells_customOptions.slider: MJSlider 140x32 at (x+w-180, y+6) using UI_slider.png / UI_sliderKnob.png; value text white (0.67 when disabled)

textEntry_GL.draw: MJButton height 48 with NO background texture; glyph textEntry.png (80x80 white rounded outline, transparent centre) stretched to frame inset 4; text centred white 16pt
textEntry_GL.label: 'WORLD NAME:' right aligned, white 16pt, box 128x16

optionsPanel.panel: pauseBackground.png (528x640) drawn at 264x320 pt centred (x +-132, y +-160)

alertDialog_BlockAlertView_UIKit.panel: alert-window.png (280x51; @2x/@3x) stretchableImage leftCap 0, topCap 38 => top 38px fixed, row 38 stretched, bottom 12px fixed; width = image width 280
alertDialog_BlockAlertView_UIKit.fonts: BlockheadsFont-Regular 16pt for title, message, buttons; white; shadowColor black, shadowOffset (0,0)
alertDialog_BlockAlertView_UIKit.padding: text inset 10 left/right (width-20); title then +10 gap
alertDialog_BlockAlertView_UIKit.buttons: UIButton height 40, row step 50, inset 10; two short buttons share a row (each (W-30)/2). Images InventoryButton* scaled to 40x40pt, capInsets trunc(6*screenScale) pt all sides; normal/highlighted = base/Selected

glUI.outlineAndShadow: baked into glyph atlas (black outline + bottom-right drop shadow); no extra shadow pass

fonts.unused: 04b03*_16 fonts / 04B_03__.TTF: no reference in the iOS client code (uncertain whether nibs use them); HelveticaNeue 12 once

sounds.certainty: certain for clicks; none found for errors/portal-enter on the menu
sounds.portalWarp: portal.wav exists but only Workbench (in-world portal) plays it; entering a world from the menu plays no SFX
sounds.music: menu loops mountainKingLoop.mp4; on New/Continue/Join it fades out (fadeOutMP3PlaybackWithFinishNotificationObject) then largo.mp4 (GameView::mainMenuSoundFinshedFadingOut)
